changelog:
- Initial release of the brainstorming skill for collaborative design before any implementation work.
- Enforces a mandatory design-first process for all projects, regardless of size or perceived simplicity.
- Guides users through a structured workflow: exploring context, clarifying requirements, proposing approaches, presenting designs, documenting specs, and obtaining user approvals.
- Includes a hard gate preventing any implementation actions until the design is approved and documented.
- Details a clear path for design documentation, self-review, user review, and structured hand-off to implementation planning.
